_machineTranslated.note: Machine-translated. No native speaker reviews this project, so reviewed stays false permanently rather than as a pending task. Quality is held by scripts/lint-locales.mjs, which checks what can be checked without fluency: key parity, placeholders, sentence terminators, register consistency, and untranslated product names.
